This structure feels right. Archived links should be absent from All, To read, Reference, and searches in those views, while search in the Archived view should search only archived links.

Permanent deletion does belong, and requiring me to archive first and then confirm deletion is a sensible safeguard. Keeping the tags, note, and reading state intact through archive and restore is exactly what I expect. I’m happy to lock in this archive-and-delete behavior.
